0022600110.text: The Pelicans (0-2, 10th in the West) visit the Denver Nuggets (0-1) for their third game of the season, having lost their last two. New Orleans is without Yves Missi (knee bruise), while Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (wrist), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring). The Pelicans lost 0-3 to Denver in the 2025-26 season series, including a 122-116 loss in New Orleans on January 13, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
